healthcareSystem: British Overseas Territory with good healthcare facilities on Grand Cayman. Health City Cayman Islands is a modern multi-specialty hospital. Cayman Islands Hospital is the public facility. Limited services on Cayman Brac and Little Cayman.
qualityNotes: Good standard of care on Grand Cayman with both public and private options. Health City Cayman Islands is a state-of-the-art facility offering advanced procedures. Cayman Islands Hospital (George Town) handles general and emergency care. Cayman Brac has a small hospital; Little Cayman has a clinic only.
pharmacyHours: Pharmacies open 8:30am-6pm weekdays, 9am-1pm Saturday. Hospital pharmacy available for emergencies.
pharmacyTips: Well-stocked pharmacies on Grand Cayman. US and UK brands widely available. Prices are higher than the US mainland. Staff speak English.
prescriptionRules: Prescription required for most medications. US and UK prescriptions generally accepted. Good availability of common medications on Grand Cayman.

restrictedMeds.name: Cannabis/CBD products
restrictedMeds.note: Illegal in the Cayman Islands. Strictly enforced at customs.

restrictedMeds.name: Controlled substances
restrictedMeds.note: Carry original prescription and a doctor's letter. Keep in original packaging.

bringDocumentation: Carry prescriptions and a doctor's letter for all medications. English documentation is standard. Keep in original packaging. If visiting Cayman Brac or Little Cayman, bring a full supply of all medications.

travelInsurance.requiredNote: The Cayman Islands requires visitors to have health insurance coverage.
travelInsurance.tips: Health insurance is mandatory for visitors. Healthcare costs are HIGH — comparable to the US. Ensure coverage includes diving and water sports, which are the most popular tourist activities.

vaccinations.notes: No special vaccinations required. Dengue fever risk exists — use insect repellent. No malaria in the Cayman Islands.

waterNotes: Tap water is safe to drink throughout the Cayman Islands. Water is produced by reverse osmosis desalination and is high quality.
foodSafetyTips: Excellent food safety standards. Restaurants are well-regulated with regular health inspections. Fresh seafood is outstanding. Food safety comparable to the US.
medicalTourismNote: Health City Cayman Islands actively promotes medical tourism, offering cardiac surgery, orthopedics, and other specialist procedures at lower prices than the US with international accreditation.
metaDescription: Health guide for the Cayman Islands. Hospital info, diving safety, mandatory health insurance, pharmacy tips, and medical tourism at Health City.

hospitals.name: Cayman Islands Hospital (George Town Hospital)
hospitals.notes: Main public hospital with 24/7 emergency department. General medical, surgical, and maternity services. Handles most tourist emergencies.

hospitals.name: Health City Cayman Islands
hospitals.nearTouristArea: East End, Grand Cayman (30 min from Seven Mile Beach)
hospitals.notes: Modern, internationally accredited private hospital. Advanced cardiac, orthopedic, and surgical care. Medical tourism facility with high standards.

hospitals.name: Faith Hospital
hospitals.notes: Small hospital on Cayman Brac. Basic emergency and inpatient care. Serious cases transferred to Grand Cayman.

dentalCare.availability: Several private dental clinics on Grand Cayman with modern equipment.
dentalCare.costRange: $100-350 USD for basic procedures — similar to US pricing
dentalCare.notes: Good quality dental care available on Grand Cayman. Prices are comparable to or slightly below US rates. Limited dental services on Cayman Brac.
dentalCare.emergencyTip: Contact Cayman Islands Hospital for after-hours dental emergencies, or call a private dental clinic for same-day appointments.

mentalHealth.internationalLine: Crisis Text Line: text HELLO to 741741 (US-based)
mentalHealth.englishTherapists: Several English-speaking therapists and counselors in private practice on Grand Cayman.
mentalHealth.notes: Mental health services available on Grand Cayman through public and private providers. Limited on the Sister Islands.

accessibilityInfo.overview: Grand Cayman has reasonable accessibility standards, especially at newer resorts and facilities.
accessibilityInfo.hospitalAccess: Both Cayman Islands Hospital and Health City are wheelchair accessible.
accessibilityInfo.transport: Public buses have limited accessibility. Taxis are the main option. Some dive operators offer adaptive diving.
accessibilityInfo.tips: Seven Mile Beach area has good accessibility at major resorts. Request accessible rooms in advance. Stingray City boat trips may be challenging for wheelchair users.

covidStatus.entryRequirements: No COVID testing or vaccination requirements for entry as of 2026.
covidStatus.maskPolicy: No mask mandates. May be requested in healthcare settings.
covidStatus.testing: Testing available at Cayman Islands Hospital and private labs.
covidStatus.notes: Cayman Islands have returned to normal operations.

insuranceClaimProcess: Hospitals accept major credit cards and most international insurance. Provide insurance details at registration. Non-insured patients pay upfront. Obtain itemized receipts with diagnosis codes for reimbursement.

commonCosts.note: Healthcare costs are HIGH. KYD is pegged at 1 KYD = 1.20 USD. Most places accept USD. Health insurance is mandatory for visitors.

medicalEvacuation.note: Air ambulance to Miami takes about 1.5 hours. Multiple daily commercial flights to the US. Cayman Islands Hospital coordinates evacuations. Health City handles most complex cases locally.

pharmacyChains.name: Health City Pharmacy
pharmacyChains.where: Health City Cayman Islands, East End
